paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper sets limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (figure 7) in mass range 1.8-18 keV from eROSITA eFEDS X-ray line search. Y-axis of fig 7 spans roughly 1e-19 to 1e-17 GeV^-1. Data points are approximate readings from figure since no numerical table is provided. Uses Caggamma=0.75 (DFSZ). DM density rho_sun=0.4 GeV/cm^3, NFW profile. The paper also constrains sterile neutrino mixing angle but ALP-photon coupling matches the AxionPhoton enum.
